title: Debezium CDC Kafka Connector Configuration
whatThisCodeCovers: A production JSON configuration for Debezium PostgreSQL connector that captures WAL logical replication events from outbox tables and transforms them into Kafka topics.
code:
/*
POST /connectors HTTP/1.1
Host: kafka-connect.internal:8083
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "postgres-outbox-connector",
  "config": {
    "connector.class": "io.debezium.connector.postgresql.PostgresConnector",
    "tasks.max": "1",
    "plugin.name": "pgoutput",
    "database.hostname": "postgres-primary.database.svc.cluster.local",
    "database.port": "5432",
    "database.user": "debezium_cdc",
    "database.password": "${file:/secrets/db-credentials.properties:cdc_password}",
    "database.dbname": "orders_db",
    "database.server.name": "orders_cdc",
    "table.include.list": "public.outbox_events",
    "tombstones.on.delete": "false",
    "decimal.handling.mode": "double",

    # SMT (Single Message Transform): Route outbox events to dynamic Kafka topics based on event_type
    "transforms": "outbox",
    "transforms.outbox.type": "io.debezium.transforms.outbox.EventRouter",
    "transforms.outbox.table.fields.additional.placement": "event_type:header:eventType",
    "transforms.outbox.route.topic.replacement": "${routedByValue}.events",
    "transforms.outbox.route.by.field": "aggregate_type",

    # Slot management
    "slot.name": "debezium_orders_slot",
    "slot.drop.on.stop": "false",
    "publication.autocreate.mode": "filtered"
  }
}
*/

// SQL script preparing PostgreSQL for Debezium logical replication:
export const dbSetupSql = `
  -- Enable logical replication in postgresql.conf: wal_level = logical
  CREATE ROLE debezium_cdc WITH REPLICATION LOGIN PASSWORD 'secret_pass';
  GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO debezium_cdc;
  ALTER TABLE public.outbox_events REPLICA IDENTITY FULL;
`;

Employs Debezium's specialized Outbox EventRouter transform to dynamically set Kafka topics.

title: Istio Strict mTLS & AuthorizationPolicy Configuration
whatThisCodeCovers: Kubernetes Istio manifests enforcing Strict mutual TLS (mTLS) across a namespace and restricting endpoint access to specific cryptographic SPIFFE identities.
code:
/*
# 1. Enforce STRICT mTLS across the entire payments namespace
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
  name: default
  namespace: payments
spec:
  mtls:
    mode: STRICT # Rejects all plaintext HTTP connections immediately!
---
# 2. Enforce Least-Privilege Authorization: Only Order Service can call Payment /v1/charges
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: payment-access-control
  namespace: payments
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-service
  action: ALLOW
  rules:
    - from:
        - source:
            principals:
              # Cryptographic identity extracted from X.509 client certificate SAN
              - "cluster.local/ns/production/sa/order-service-account"
      to:
        - operation:
            methods: ["POST"]
            paths: ["/v1/charges"]
*/
breakdown: Sets PeerAuthentication mode to STRICT to enforce 100% encrypted mTLS.
Rejects any pod connecting without a valid in-cluster mesh certificate.
Enforces fine-grained path and HTTP method authorization using SPIFFE principal names.
Prevents lateral movement if another pod in the cluster is compromised.
expectedOutput: All traffic into payments is encrypted with mTLS; only order-service-account can POST /v1/charges.

title: Istio Fault Injection for Chaos Testing

kind: VirtualService

spec:
  hosts:

  http:

*/

title: OpenTelemetry Collector Tail-Based Sampling Pipeline
whatThisCodeCovers: A production otel-collector.yaml configuration buffering spans in memory and executing tail-based sampling rules to retain 100% of errors and slow requests.
code:
/*
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

processors:
  batch:
    send_batch_size: 1000
    timeout: 5s

  # Tail-Based Sampling Processor: buffers traces and evaluates completion rules
  tail_sampling:
    decision_wait: 10s # Wait 10 seconds for all child spans to arrive
    num_traces: 50000
    expected_new_traces_per_sec: 3000
    policies:
      # Rule 1: Always retain traces with errors (100% capture of bugs)
      - name: drop-errors-policy
        type: status_code
        status_code:
          status_codes: [ERROR]

      # Rule 2: Always retain traces that exceed 1200ms (p99 latency analysis)
      - name: latency-outlier-policy
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 1200

      # Rule 3: Sample remaining healthy 200 OK traffic at 2%
      - name: probabilistic-healthy-sample
        type: probabilistic
        probabilistic:
          sampling_percentage: 2.0

exporters:
  otlp/tempo:
    endpoint: tempo-distributor.monitoring:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [tail_sampling, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/tempo]
*/
breakdown: Receives OTLP telemetry over gRPC (4317) and HTTP (4318).
Buffers traces for 10 seconds to inspect the completed trace DAG.
Guarantees that 100% of error traces and p99 latency spikes are retained.
Reduces overall telemetry storage costs by 95% via probabilistic sampling of healthy traffic.
expectedOutput: Collector buffers spans; exports 100% of errors/slow spans and 2% of healthy spans to Tempo.

title: ArgoCD Application Manifest with Automated Drift Healing
whatThisCodeCovers: A declarative ArgoCD Application manifest establishing Git as the Single Source of Truth, enabling automated drift detection and self-healing.
code:
/*
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: order-service-prod
  namespace: argocd
  finalizers:
    - resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: "https://github.com/enterprise/gitops-deployments.git"
    targetRevision: main
    path: overlays/production/order-service
  destination:
    server: "https://kubernetes.default.svc"
    namespace: production
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true     # Automatically deletes K8s resources removed from Git
      selfHeal: true  # Automatically reverts manual ad-hoc 'kubectl edit' changes!
    syncOptions:
      - CreateNamespace=true
      - PruneLast=true
    retry:
      limit: 5
      backoff:
        duration: 5s
        factor: 2
        maxDuration: 3m
*/

Enables selfHeal: true to overwrite unauthorized manual kubectl alterations.

expectedOutput: ArgoCD reconciles cluster to Git state; reverts manual kubectl edits automatically.
